Thanks Hannah — below is the recommended approach and what we can include in the sample bundle. Feel free to edit before we send to Raj.

Quick summary of what we log (admin/activity plane):
- Admin user management: create / update / deactivate / role assignment (actor, target_user_id, timestamp, ip, request_id)
- API key lifecycle: create / revoke / rotate (key_id masked, actor, timestamp)
- Deployment actions: model upload, version pin, rollback, canary rollouts (model_id, artifact_hash, actor, timestamp)
- Billing & quota operations: plan changes, limit overrides, invoice events (event_type, amount, actor, timestamp)
- Console actions: UI-driven permission grants, SSO mappings, MFA / auth config changes
- Service-level: token issuance, cache purge, prefix cache hits/misses (sampling)

Retention windows (default):
- Admin activity events: 540 days (18 months)
- API key ops & credential metadata: 540 days
- Deployment metadata and artifact hashes: 540 days
- Full request traces (raw request/response bodies): 90 days (redacted by default)

Export options we can offer for the 30-day sample:
Option A (fast sample - 48 hours): gzipped ndjson bundle containing event records (schema v2), an export_manifest_orca_YYYYMMDD.txt with SHA256 checksums, and a short audit note listing the filters used. File delivered as attachment or secure Drive link.
Option B (secure transfer - 3 business days): Deliver to customer's S3 bucket via presigned Put URL + server-side encryption SSE-KMS. Includes signed manifest, SHA256, and a brief notarization (operator name + timestamp). We also emit a transfer log entry into our audit system for chain-of-custody.
Option C (streaming / ingest integration): Send to their Splunk / Datadog intake with field mappings (requires onboarding work; ETA 1-2 weeks).

Redaction / PII: We can redact user_email fields and replace with hashed identifiers on request; raw request bodies are not included in the standard sample unless explicitly requested and approved.

Checksums & manifest: We use SHA256 for each archive member, and create a manifest signed by the staff who prepared the bundle. We can also provide a GPG-signed manifest on request.

Attachments to include in sample reply:
- export_manifest_template.yml (manifest format example)
- orca_admin_sample_202608-202609.ndjson.gz (sample bundle; redacted)

Turnaround/approvals: anything <= 90 days can be produced with engineering ops sign-off and security review (no legal required). Exports > 90 days need a written request and may require compliance lead approval.

Let me know if you want me to prepare the Option A sample and I'll assemble the bundle.
